definitions.explanation: A condition in which blood pressure is lower than normal, often causing symptoms like dizziness or fatigue.

examples.japanese: {低血圧|ていけつあつ}で{朝|あさ}が{苦手|にがて}だ。
examples.english: I have trouble with mornings because of low blood pressure.

examples.japanese: {低血圧|ていけつあつ}の{症状|しょうじょう}にはめまいがある。
examples.english: Symptoms of low blood pressure include dizziness.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{低血圧|ていけつあつ}なので、{急|きゅう}に{立|た}ち{上|あ}がるとふらふらする。
examples.english: She has low blood pressure, so she feels dizzy when she stands up quickly.

examples.japanese: {低血圧|ていけつあつ}の{人|ひと}は{朝|あさ}なかなか{起|お}きられないことが{多|おお}い。
examples.english: People with low blood pressure often have trouble getting up in the morning.

examples.japanese: {医者|いしゃ}に{低血圧|ていけつあつ}だと{言|い}われて、{塩分|えんぶん}を{少|すこ}し{多|おお}めに{取|と}るように{勧|すす}められた。
examples.english: The doctor told me I have low blood pressure and recommended that I consume a bit more salt.

notes:
SIMILAR WORDS:
- {高血圧|こうけつあつ} (high blood pressure, hypertension)

RELATED MEDICAL TERMS:
- {血圧|けつあつ} (blood pressure)
- {血圧計|けつあつけい} (blood pressure monitor)
- {起立性低血圧|きりつせいていけつあつ} (orthostatic hypotension)

SYMPTOMS:
- めまい (dizziness)
- {立|た}ちくらみ (lightheadedness upon standing)
- {疲労感|ひろうかん} (fatigue)
- {朝|あさ}が{弱|よわ}い (difficulty waking up)

CULTURAL NOTE: In Japan, being {低血圧|ていけつあつ} is commonly given as an explanation for being sluggish in the morning or having difficulty waking up, though the medical connection is not strongly supported.
